title: Official ConvIR-B OTS baseline behavior complete-scene supplement
rationale: The direct parent ended INCONCLUSIVE solely because a long-edge-320 resize made the short edge too small for an internal official ConvIR-B reflection pad in 218 aspect-ratio-extreme scenes. Parent and dataset identities matched, the GPU contract passed, and 407 scenes completed, but those diagnostic outcomes cannot substitute for the frozen 625-scene population. This one supplement recomputes all 625 scenes and all three frozen variants while preserving the parent's aspect-ratio-preserving content resize exactly. The sole change reflect-extends the bottom and right model canvas to at least 256 pixels per dimension and then to a multiple of 32; prediction is cropped back to the unpadded content before GT, depth, tau, region, PSNR, SSIM or mismatch measurement. The 256 model-canvas minimum follows directly from the unchanged production graph: a 1/4-scale feature is pooled by 8 before ReflectionPad2d(7), so the pooled dimension must be at least 8. Synthetic 32x320 and 320x32 content fixtures cover both exact formal aspect-ratio boundaries and exercise 256x320 and 320x256 CUDA model canvases. Model, content resolution, population, variants, regions, estimand, margins, negative control, uncertainty, and terminal rules remain unchanged.

scientific_contract.question: After correcting only the parent route's aspect-ratio-dependent preprocessing incompatibility, does the fixed official Haze4K ConvIR-B baseline show a material and tau-aligned local restoration mismatch on all 625 frozen OTS validation scenes?

intervention.reference: paired hazy input versus clear GT, with true tau regions compared against the same tau field rotated 180 degrees within scene
intervention.matched_budget: the exact same 625 independent scenes times the same three nested official variants; one fixed checkpoint; zero training or model selection
fixed_factors: scene membership is exactly the 625 IDs archived by reside-ots-baseline-behavior-v1
official variants remain airlight 0.90 crossed with beta 0.04, 0.10, and 0.20
content preprocessing remains the parent rule: preserve aspect ratio, cap the long edge at 320 pixels, and never upscale source content

the sole parent-contract change reflect-extends only the bottom and right model canvas to at least 256 pixels per dimension and then to a multiple of 32, derived from the official 1/4-scale then pool-8 then ReflectionPad2d(7) path
model prediction is cropped to the exact unpadded content size before every GT, depth, tau, region, PSNR, SSIM or mismatch calculation; padded pixels never enter an estimand
official build_net('base','Haze4K') is strictly loaded from checkpoint state_dict['model'] and model(input)[2] is cropped and clipped to [0,1]
pixel input error is mean RGB squared error between hazy input and clear GT; output error replaces input with clipped model output
relative correction remains (mean input error minus mean output error) divided by mean input error with epsilon 1e-8
true low and high regions remain the within-scene bottom and top 20 percent of tau; the negative control rotates tau 180 degrees
a variant mismatch still requires true low-minus-high relative correction at least 0.10 and true-minus-control imbalance at least 0.05
a scene mismatch still requires the variant rule in at least two of the three fixed beta severities
pixels, regions, beta variants, and metrics remain nested summaries rather than independent samples
all 625 scenes are recomputed; no parent scientific outcome is pooled, reused, or used to alter a threshold

primary_estimand.metric: proportion of 625 independent OTS clear scenes meeting the unchanged tau-aligned mismatch indicator in at least two of three severities
primary_estimand.aggregation: scene-level binary indicator with two-sided Wilson 95 percent interval

controls: strict identity-bound official checkpoint and official production graph
full-image input-to-output MSE improvement as the unchanged OTS global-competence prerequisite
180-degree spatial rotation of tau within scene as the unchanged marginal-distribution-preserving negative control
paired clear GT and identical resize/crop for input, output, depth, and regions
32x320 and 320x32 synthetic-content GPU no-data fixtures that exercise both formal aspect-ratio boundaries, safe model canvases and exact content crop
a protected-data-free elementwise reference proving safe canvas extension equals the former PyTorch bottom-right reflection pad whenever the former one-pass pad is valid

uncertainty.method: two-sided Wilson 95 percent intervals over the same 625 independent original clear scenes; severity and pixels remain nested

gates.estimand: parent INCONCLUSIVE supplement authorization, 625-scene list, checkpoint and model-source identities match
independent scenes with all three fixed variants, aligned depth and finite inference
Wilson lower 95 percent bound for scenes whose full-image output MSE is below input MSE in at least two of three severities
Wilson interval for tau-aligned scene mismatch prevalence
included in each variant indicator as true low-high correction imbalance minus rotated-tau imbalance

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: An apparent high-versus-low difference can reflect spatial content rather than tau, addressed only descriptively by the rotated-tau control. The supplement also tests whether the parent result was distorted by aspect-ratio-dependent completion. Passing remains synthetic-domain behavior of one fixed model, not causal or real-haze evidence.
disabled_actions: any change beyond the minimum-short-edge preprocessing compatibility correction
training, fine-tuning, module insertion, candidate selection, loss selection, or hyperparameter search
changing population, variants, regions, estimand, margins, controls, uncertainty, or terminal rules
using model output to define tau or region membership
SOTS, Haze4K outcome, NH-HAZE, confirmation, canary, or locked-test access
a second preprocessing supplement after this route

precision_contract.rationale: The unchanged 625-scene set exceeds the worst-case 601 independent groups required for a two-sided 95 percent proportion half-width of 0.04.

capability.production_path_statement: The exact official graph strictly loads the official checkpoint and executes the unchanged content resize plus deterministic reflect-extension of 32x320 and 320x32 synthetic content tensors to 256x320 and 320x256 CUDA model canvases, model(input)[2], exact content crop, clip, metric and finalizer path without scientific data.

precision.source_reference: The archived parent scene list contains exactly 625 independent clear scenes; ceil(1.96^2*0.25/0.04^2)=601.
